note: All businesses, suppliers, people, amounts, addresses and phone numbers are fictional test fixtures.

tests.setup: Owner presses Set up Inbox Agent. Separately: owner has approved 5 unchanged payments each to 3 suppliers.

tests.setup: Inbox connected.

tests.setup: Month counter at 482 of 500; inbox has 31 documents.

expect.shows: Run stopped at the limit; processed vs untouched counts; reset date; nothing paid or sent
